purpose: Check the actual NTC without waiting for a manufacturer email; one sample measurement does not establish production tolerances.
charger_source: Microchip DS20002090F electrical characteristics: I_THERM 47–53 uA; cold 1.20–1.26 V; hot 0.23–0.27 V
measurement_plan: Disconnect the pack from all electronics. Measure NTC-to-protected-negative resistance, not across the power terminals.

Stabilize an uncharged/unloaded pack in a controlled dry environment at 0, 5, 25, 40 and 45 C, with an independent contact temperature probe. Never heat or cool by charging the pack; avoid condensation.
Record temperature, resistance, instrument uncertainty, settling time and sample identity. Account for uncertainty before comparing boundary limits.
For the assembled board, emulate the NTC with a resistance box and verify charge suspension at both boundaries and sensor open/short. Use a suitable battery simulator or controlled bench setup.

Verify thermal attachment/lag and cutoff behavior with the actual pack, then log current, voltage, temperature, termination and elapsed time through a supervised cycle. Stop if a pack limit is exceeded.
failure_action: If the actual NTC cannot meet the cutoff window, do not bypass it. Engineer a specified external NTC/conditioning network or change pack, then repeat qualification.
limits: Sensor characterization requires physical hardware and test instruments.
Temperature cutoff, retention, wire routing, runtime and safe portable charging are not verified by CAD or a netlist.
